_provenance: Condition registry for the July 2026 main study (and later additions). Paths are relative to zylia_analysis/. June pilot outputs (results/, results/gt, results/virtual, results/virtual_selfcal, results/optim/predictions.json) are frozen artifacts: no condition may write into them. calibration.mode 'self' fits the Zylia mount on this condition's own pink-noise trials; 'external' applies the mount from the source condition's summary.json. mount_model: offset | rotation | auto. `only` (string or list) restricts discover_sessions() to folders whose name contains ALL of the given substrings; `exclude` (string or list) drops any folder containing ANY of them -- used below to split one shared data_root into per-combination conditions.
_new_experiment_note: pn_/mphon_/fphon_ x s1/s2/outer x mono/vbap x cc/co (36 conditions, added 2026-09-25): the new clip-log-format experiment (unity.parse_clip_log), one shared data_root filtered by folder-name substrings (stimulus family, speaker rig, VBAP-vs-mono, curtain state). Male_Phonemes and Female_Phonemes are kept as separate conditions (not merged into one 'phonemes' condition). Each mphon_/fphon_ condition has no pink-noise trials of its own, so it borrows ('external') the mount fit from the pn_ condition sharing its rig/render/curtain -- the mounting is a property of the physical rig, not the stimulus played. Comparisons across these conditions (e.g. VBAP vs mono, curtain open vs closed) are not yet wired into `comparisons` below; add them once results are in.

vbap_gtmount._note: Sensitivity check: same VBAP data scored under the ground-truth mount instead of its own self-fit (mount-transfer disagreement bound).

atmos._note: Flip enabled to true once the Dolby Atmos sessions are recorded.

ambi._note: Recorded 2026-07-15 but EXCLUDED: the three elevation blocks carry a large per-block frame rotation (~91 deg azimuth spread, tracking recording time not elevation) traced to a data-collection issue (mic reorientation and/or per-block decode frame). No defensible VBAP comparison until provenance is resolved. Do not re-enable without that. See memory ambisonics-data-status.

ambi_gtmount._note: Ambisonics under the ground-truth mount; EXCLUDED with the ambi condition (per-block frame confound). Kept as infrastructure for the post-provenance re-analysis.

pn_s12_mono_cc._note: Setup1 + Setup2 physical pink-noise, curtain closed, pooled into one condition. 'Pink_' (not 'Pink_Noise') to also match the one lowercase 'Pink_noise_Setup2_CC_' folder. REVISED 2026-10-06 (twice): mount_model was briefly forced to 'offset' suspecting an overfit tilt, but switching models alone just changed which ~1/3 of positions passed the robust inlier gate (and therefore which positions silently counted in every downstream stat) -- it did not fix the real problem. The real issue: Setup1's own pink noise corrects to ~21 deg but Setup2's corrects to ~46 deg even within this SAME condition under a single pooled mount -- the Zylia was very likely physically remounted/repositioned between the Setup1 and Setup2 recording sessions (different days), so no single mount (offset OR rotation) can represent both. 'per_session': true fits and applies a SEPARATE mount per RIG (parsed from the folder name via run_analysis._rig_of -- 'setup1'/'setup2') instead of one pooled compromise, and run_analysis.py now propagates that per-rig mapping ('per_rig_mounts' in summary.json) to every externally-calibrated child condition (fphon_s12_mono_cc, newstim_s12_mono_cc), matching each of ITS sessions to the correct rig by the same folder-name parsing. mount_model restored to 'auto' since each rig's fit is now independent and can no longer be contaminated by the other rig's data.

pn_s12_vbap_cc._note: Setup1 + Setup2 VBAP pink-noise, curtain closed, pooled into one condition (self-calibrates on the combined pink-noise trials). Updated 2026-10-03 to the RE-RECORDED '01_pink_noise_setup{1,2}_vbap_CC_...' sessions (the original 'Pink_Noise_VBAP_Setup{1,2}_CC_...' sessions were truncated early); the new filter's lowercase tokens naturally exclude the old capital-case folders, no explicit exclude needed for them. 'per_session': true added 2026-10-06 for consistency with pn_s12_mono_cc: this condition's own rotation fit only passed 9/~27 positions as inliers (handedness flipped/reflection warning), meaning roughly 2/3 of its positions were ALSO being silently excluded from every downstream stat under the old pooled fit -- verify the per-rig corrected numbers still look reasonable per setup now that all positions are included.

newstim_s12_mono_cc._note: Setup1 + Setup2 physical recordings of the five new stimuli added 2026-10 (250/1000/5000 Hz tones, phone ringing, applause), curtain closed, pooled into one condition -- 'only' matches on the shared '200ms'/'_CC_'/'mono' tokens since the per-family folder-naming prefixes differ (e.g. '250hz200ms_...', 'phone_ringing_200ms_...', 'applause_200ms_...'). Mount fit shared with 'pn_s12_mono_cc' (same physical rig/render/curtain state); this condition has no pink-noise trials of its own to self-calibrate on.

newstim_s12_vbap_cc._note: Setup1 + Setup2 VBAP recordings of the five new stimuli added 2026-10 (250/1000/5000 Hz tones, phone ringing, applause), curtain closed, pooled into one condition (see newstim_s12_mono_cc for the folder-naming rationale). Mount fit shared with 'pn_s12_vbap_cc' (same physical rig/render/curtain state); this condition has no pink-noise trials of its own to self-calibrate on.
